expectedRealization.rationale: Rare-earth price/volume and export-control scarcity can move earnings expectations within one to two reporting cycles.

changeHypothesis.summary: Q2 rare-earth export controls became a real physical magnet bottleneck. 北方稀土 already had a realized price-and-volume earnings bridge in Q1: higher average rare-earth prices plus materially higher sales volumes drove revenue +61%, profit +727% and positive operating cash flow. By June 20 the sector price regime was favorable but not yet extreme.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Physical export shipments collapsed in May while company Q1 operating data had already shown strong price/volume earnings conversion.
disconfirmingEvidence: Export controls can hurt downstream magnet export volumes.
Forward valuation was already around high-30s/40x rather than cheap.
Policy can loosen and reduce scarcity premium.

causalChain.mechanism: Licensing delays and collapsed magnet exports reveal a real supply-chain bottleneck rather than policy rhetoric.
causalChain.failureMode: licensing normalizes quickly or end demand collapses

causalChain.mechanism: Q1 already demonstrated that higher average rare-earth prices, lower raw-material cost and much higher sales volumes translate directly into revenue/profit/cash.
causalChain.failureMode: feedstock cost rises faster than selling prices or controls reduce realizable volumes

causalChain.mechanism: The selected producer must sustain the realized bridge at a valuation burden no worse than peers.
causalChain.failureMode: sector rerates faster than earnings or a peer has greater profit torque

directWinners: upstream/integrated rare-earth producers with pricing power
secondOrderWinners: qualified magnet producers if export licenses permit shipments
falseThemeMatches: magnet/export names that face volume restrictions without price capture

aShareCandidates.name: 北方稀土
aShareCandidates.verifiedExposure: Q1 rare-earth oxide/metal/magnetic-material sales volumes rose roughly 47-58%; higher average rare-earth prices and lower raw-material cost drove profit/cash conversion.

earningsSensitivity.base: 2025E profit around RMB2.0-2.1bn at high-30s/around-40x PE.
earningsSensitivity.favorable: scarcity supports price while high production/sales volumes persist.
earningsSensitivity.adverse: license normalization or raw-material cost inflation compresses spread.

aShareCandidates.verifiedExposure: Q1 revenue more than doubled and profit turned positive, but operating cash flow remained negative.

aShareCandidates.verifiedExposure: Q1 profit turned strongly positive but revenue growth was modest and cash flow remained negative.

matchedControls.fairCounterfactualReason: Direct listed rare-earth producer exposed to the same policy/price cycle.
matchedControls.whySelectedCompanyShouldOutperform: 北方稀土 had positive operating cash flow, broader volume evidence and a lower frozen valuation burden.

matchedControls.fairCounterfactualReason: Integrated rare-earth peer exposed to the same price cycle.
matchedControls.whySelectedCompanyShouldOutperform: 北方稀土 had much stronger revenue/volume acceleration and positive cash conversion while forward valuation was broadly comparable.

selectedDisadvantages: 中国稀土 may have greater percentage earnings torque from a lower base
pairwise.switchCondition: Switch if 中国稀土 cash conversion normalizes and its earnings revisions accelerate faster without a richer valuation.

selectedAdvantages: direct company explanation of price/volume margin conversion
selectedDisadvantages: 盛和 may have higher commodity beta in a sharp price spike
pairwise.switchCondition: Switch if 盛和 shows superior realized price/spread sensitivity and cash conversion at comparable valuation.

selectionComparison.rationale: 北方稀土 combines the cleanest realized conversion bridge, acceptable valuation relative to peers and the strongest operating/cash evidence.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: Q1 earnings recovery was known and analyst references implied roughly high-30s/40x 2025E PE; by June the physical export bottleneck intensified while the sector's 20/60d relative regime remained positive but not extreme.
expectations.thesisExpectation: The Q1 price/volume earnings bridge persists or strengthens as physical scarcity supports rare-earth pricing.
expectations.measurableGap: The thesis does not require a new business model—only continued realized price/volume conversion faster than the already-known Q1 baseline.

expectationBurdenTest.valuationMethod: Forward PE plus realized price/volume earnings sensitivity versus rare-earth peers.
expectationBurdenTest.marketBaseline: 2025E profit roughly RMB2.0-2.1bn and forward PE around high-30s/40x in contemporaneous references.
expectationBurdenTest.thesisScenario: Rare-earth scarcity keeps realized selling prices/volumes sufficiently strong to lift 2025 earnings above the frozen baseline.
expectationBurdenTest.breakevenCondition: Price/volume economics must sustain Q1 profit/cash conversion; no major multiple expansion is required, but the 40x-like burden leaves limited room for execution misses.
expectationBurdenTest.ordinaryScenarioFailure: Policy tightness is temporary or feedstock costs absorb selling-price gains, leaving earnings near baseline while the sector multiple compresses.
expectationBurdenTest.catalystOrTimingBridge: June export-flow bottlenecks and the next quarterly operating data can verify price/volume persistence within 20-60 trading days.

fundamentalAcceleration.rationale: Q1 price/volume economics and June physical export bottlenecks both strengthened the rare-earth scarcity signal.

realizedCompanyConfirmation.rationale: Higher average rare-earth prices plus materially higher sales volumes already converted into revenue, profit and positive CFO.

crossSectionalConfirmation.rationale: Peers improved too, but 北方稀土 had better cash conversion, scale and comparable/lower valuation burden.

baselineLag.rationale: The frozen earnings baseline preceded the full June evidence of physical export scarcity.

priceAbsorption.checkMethod: Use deterministic sector 20/60d relative regime and frozen forward valuation references.

priceRegime.method: equal-weight frozen rare-earth basket versus CSI300

fundamentalImpulse.rationale: Policy restrictions became a measurable physical magnet shortage while company price/volume economics were already improving.

earningsRevisionBreadth.rationale: 北方稀土, 中国稀土 and 盛和 all showed substantial Q1 earnings improvement from prior weak bases.

eventHalfLife.rationale: Licensing/supply-chain controls and mine/separation constraints cannot normalize instantly.

lateCycleRisk.rationale: 20/60d breadth is fully positive, but relative excess is far below the extreme Q3 late-cycle state observed in development data.

opportunityTimingTest.rationale: Fundamentals, revisions and pre-cutoff price breadth are aligned.

qualityFloor.rationale: Positive profit, positive operating cash flow, large cash balance and broad production/sales scale clear the quality floor.

revisionHeadroom.rationale: June physical bottleneck strengthened after the contemporaneous earnings baseline was published.

valuationSlack.rationale: Forward valuation around high-30s/40x is not cheap, but is comparable to 盛和 and below 中国稀土's richer burden.

catalystReachability.rationale: Rare-earth pricing/export data and the next quarterly operating report lie within the 60d base horizon.

downsideContainment.rationale: The thesis begins from already-profitable, cash-generative operations rather than requiring a loss-to-profit turn.

pairwise.revisionAdvantage: Both have recovery torque, but 北方稀土 already converts price/volume into cash earnings at much greater scale.
pairwise.valuationAdvantage: 北方稀土 carries the lower frozen valuation burden.
pairwise.qualityTradeoff: 北方稀土 has superior cash conversion and operating scale.
pairwise.catalystAdvantage: Both share the scarcity catalyst; 北方稀土 has direct quarterly operating-volume disclosure.
pairwise.downsideTradeoff: 中国稀土 still has weaker cash conversion and richer valuation.
pairwise.switchCondition: Switch if 中国稀土 develops positive cash conversion and faster earnings revisions at a comparable burden.

pairwise.revisionAdvantage: 北方稀土 has broader realized volume acceleration and a direct price/volume bridge.
pairwise.qualityTradeoff: 北方稀土 positive CFO versus 盛和 negative CFO.
pairwise.catalystAdvantage: Both share the price catalyst; 北方稀土 has stronger direct operating evidence.
pairwise.downsideTradeoff: Positive cash conversion gives 北方稀土 a better ordinary-scenario floor.
pairwise.switchCondition: Switch if 盛和 demonstrates stronger realized spread/cash sensitivity without a valuation premium.

earningsConversionBridge.driverChange: Q1 rare-earth average prices rose and sales volumes increased sharply; June export/licensing bottlenecks further tightened physical supply.
earningsConversionBridge.earningsMechanism: Higher realized rare-earth prices plus high sales volumes expand revenue/gross profit, while the company already demonstrated positive cash conversion.
earningsConversionBridge.nextObservableMetric: next-quarter realized rare-earth prices, sales volumes, gross profit and operating cash flow
earningsConversionBridge.failureCondition: selling prices/volumes weaken or feedstock costs rise enough that gross profit and cash conversion fail to sustain the Q1 improvement.

valuationExecution.valuationContext: High-priority despite a tight valuation burden because the conversion bridge is already realized and timing/asymmetry gates are favorable.

bearCase: Licensing normalizes, rare-earth prices soften or raw-material cost rises; the sector keeps a rich multiple while earnings revert toward baseline.

invalidationConditions.threshold: price/volume/gross profit fail to sustain Q1 improvement
rapid normalization removes the scarcity mechanism

unknowns: exact Q2 realized product pricing by category
nextResearchActions: Evaluate at 20/60/120d versus both controls and CSI300.
